persona: Sofia, 31, Lisbon. Long-term investor on Trading 212 (EUR account): fractional US shares and a UK-listed ETF priced in pence. Wants her real return in EUR and per-position P&L without spreadsheets.

broker_reference.note: Trading 212 reports Result in the account currency (EUR) using the FX rate at each fill; per-currency gross above is in the instrument currency.

traps: VUSA price in GBX (pence): 9412.00 GBX = 94.12 GBP; P&L must not be 100x
Action values: 'Market buy', 'Limit buy', 'Market sell', 'Dividend (Dividend)', 'Deposit', 'Interest on cash'
No commission, but a 'Currency conversion fee' in EUR on every USD/GBX trade
Total and Result are in EUR while the price is in USD/GBX; the price column is 'Price / share'
Two currency columns per row: 'Currency (Price / share)' is the trade currency, 'Currency (Total)' is the account currency
Dividend row has 'No. of shares' and 'Price / share' = dividend per share: must not be imported as a trade
